Shared domain: entities, enums, value objects, lifecycle FSM db/ # SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, repository layer auth/ # OIDC/RBAC middleware, token validation, group mapping ingest/ # Upload endpoint, file validation, queue dispatch processing/ # Next.js 14 app router components/ # Shadcn/UI based shared components features/ # Feature slices: dashboard, validation, search, export, qa lib/ # API client, auth hooks, state (Zustand + TanStack Query) infra/ profiles/ # Profile YAML/env resolution docker/ # Dockerfiles, compose migrations/ # Alembic env and versions (symlinked from src/backend/db) test/ backend/ # Mirrors src/backend structure frontend/ # Mirrors src/frontend structure integration/ # Cross-service integration tests ``` ### Slice Map | Slice | Primary Namespace | Track | Owning REQs | |---|---|---|---| | data-backbone | `backend.core`, `backend.db` | Data | REQ-001 | | profile-adapters | `backend.adapters`, `infra.profiles` | Infra | REQ-002 | | auth | `backend.auth` | App | REQ-003 | | ingest | `backend.ingest` | App | REQ-004 | | processing | `backend.processing` | App | REQ-005 | | validation | `backend.validation` | App | REQ-006 | | archive-search | `backend.archive` | App | REQ-007 | | export | `backend.export` | App | REQ-008 | | rag | `backend.rag` | App | REQ-009 | | frontend-shell | `frontend.app`, `frontend.lib`, `frontend.components` | App | REQ-010 | | frontend-features | `frontend.features` | App | REQ-011 | | observability | `backend.adapters.observability`, `infra` | Infra | REQ-012 | ## REQ-IDs Table | ID | Title | Acceptance (≤3 bullets) | DependsOn [IDs] | Track | Status | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | REQ-001 | Canonical data contract backbone and migrations | Alembic migrations create all core tables

Download endpoint with auth and audit logging | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007 | App | open | | REQ-009 | Validated-only RAG pipeline and Q&A endpoint | Embedding pipeline indexes only Validated documents into pgvector
Q&A endpoint retrieves, reranks, and generates answer
Non-validated documents never enter vector store | REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007 | App | open | | REQ-010 | Frontend shell, auth, and shared components | Next.js 14 app shell with OIDC login flow
Shared layout, navigation, Shadcn/UI component library
TanStack Query and Zustand providers configured | REQ-003 | App | open | | REQ-011 | Frontend feature slices: dashboard, validation, search, export, Q&A | Dashboard shows ingest and validation stats
Validation inbox with approve/reject actions
Search, export initiation, and Q&A chat interface | REQ-010, REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009 | App | open | | REQ-012 | Observability: structured logging, tracing, metrics | OpenTelemetry tracing on all backend services
Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint
Structured logging routed via profile-driven sink adapter | REQ-002 | Infra | open | ### Acceptance — REQ-001 - Alembic migration creates tables: `documents`, `document_versions`, `document_metadata`, `processing_jobs`, `validation_tasks`, `export_jobs`, `audit_log`, `users`, `user_roles` - `DocumentState` enum defines: `Uploaded`, `Processing`, `AwaitingValidation`, `Validated`, `Rejected`, `Archived`, `ExportReady` with allowed transitions enforced in code - Each table includes `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by` audit columns - `documents` table has business key `external_ref` (unique), plus `state`, `content_hash`, `file_type`, `original_filename`, `storage_key` - Repository layer provides typed CRUD operations for each entity with SQLAlchemy async session - All entity models importable from `backend.core.models` and `backend.db.models` - State transition function raises `InvalidStateTransition` for disallowed moves - Migration is idempotent: running twice produces no error and no schema drift - PII-relevant columns are annotated with a `pii=True` marker for downstream log redaction - Test: migration up/down roundtrip succeeds; state FSM rejects invalid transitions; repository CRUD happy path; audit columns auto-populated ### Acceptance — REQ-002 - Abstract adapter interfaces defined in `backend.adapters.contracts`: `ObjectStorageAdapter`, `QueueAdapter`, `EventAdapter`, `SecretsAdapter`, `LogSinkAdapter` - AWS implementations: S3, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch Logs - On-prem implementations: S3-compatible (MinIO), approved queue stub, approved event stub, Vault, centralized log stub - `ProfileResolver` reads `DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE` env var (`aws` or `onprem`) and returns the correct adapter set - Adapter selection is validated at startup; unknown profile raises `UnsupportedProfile` error - Each adapter has an integration test using localstack (aws) or minio/stub (onprem) - No business logic in adapter modules; adapters are pure infrastructure wrappers - Adapter contracts are importable from `backend.adapters.contracts` by all downstream REQs - Test: profile resolver returns correct adapters for each profile; unknown profile raises error; object storage adapter put/get roundtrip; queue adapter send/receive roundtrip ### Acceptance — REQ-003 - FastAPI middleware validates OIDC JWT tokens on every protected route - `require_role(role: str)` decorator returns 403 with audit log entry when role is missing - Unauthenticated requests return 401 with `WWW-Authenticate` header - User identity extracted from token and available via `request.state.user` - RBAC roles: `admin`, `operator`, `viewer`, `service` mapped from IdP groups - Audit log entry written to `audit_log` table for every 401 and 403 event - Auth module reusable by all downstream REQs via `from backend.auth import require_role, get_current_user` - Token validation supports RS256 with JWKS endpoint discovery - Test: valid token grants access; expired token returns 401; missing role returns 403 with audit record; service token accepted for inter-service calls ### Acceptance — REQ-004 - `POST /api/v1/documents/upload` accepts multipart file upload with metadata JSON - File type validated against allowed list (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, png); unsupported type returns 422 - File stored via `ObjectStorageAdapter.put()` with generated storage key - Document record created in `Uploaded` state with metadata persisted - `document.ingested` event dispatched to processing queue via `QueueAdapter` - Upload is idempotent by `content_hash`: duplicate file returns existing document ID - Audit log entry for each successful upload - File size limit enforced (configurable, default 100MB); oversized file returns 413 - Test: upload valid PDF creates document in Uploaded state; duplicate upload returns same ID; unsupported type returns 422; oversized file returns 413; queue message dispatched; unauthenticated upload returns 401 ### Acceptance — REQ-005 - Queue consumer listens for `document.ingested` events - OCR pipeline: Tesseract + PaddleOCR/docTR applied based on file type - Classification: configurable rules engine assigns document category - Extraction: Apache Tika + Unstructured extract structured text and metadata - Extracted text and metadata persisted to `document_metadata` and `document_versions` - Document transitions from `Uploaded` → `Processing` → `AwaitingValidation` - Processing failure transitions document to `Processing` with error details and retry count - Max 3 retries; after max retries, document stays in `Processing` with `requires_manual_review` flag - Processing job record tracks start time, end time, status, error details - Test: valid PDF processed end-to-end reaches AwaitingValidation; unsupported content triggers error path; retry logic respects max retries; extracted text persisted; processing job record created ### Acceptance — REQ-006 - `GET /api/v1/validation/tasks` returns paginated list of documents in `AwaitingValidation` state - `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/approve` transitions document to `Validated` state - `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/reject` transitions document to `Rejected` state with reason - `POST /api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/reprocess` transitions document back to `Uploaded` for re-processing - Only `operator` and `admin` roles can perform validation actions - Each action writes audit log entry with operator identity, action, timestamp, and reason - Approved document's `validated_by` and `validated_at` fields populated - Concurrent validation of same document by two operators prevented (optimistic locking) - `viewer` role can list tasks but cannot perform actions (returns 403) - Test: approve transitions to Validated with audit; reject transitions to Rejected with reason; reprocess re-queues; viewer gets 403 on action; concurrent approve raises conflict error ### Acceptance — REQ-007 - Validated documents automatically archived: metadata indexed, storage key confirmed - `GET /api/v1/archive/search` supports full-text query, date range, document type, category filters - Search results include document metadata, snippet, and download link - Only documents in `Validated` or `Archived` state appear in search results - Pagination with cursor-based navigation - Search query logged to audit log with user identity - Archive transition: `Validated` → `Archived` (automatic after configurable delay or immediate) - Full-text index uses PostgreSQL `tsvector` on extracted text - Test: search returns only validated/archived documents; non-validated documents excluded; full-text search matches expected terms; pagination returns correct pages; unauthenticated search returns 401 ### Acceptance — REQ-008 - `POST /api/v1/export/jobs` creates export job for selected document IDs with format (PDF, CSV, ZIP) - Export job runs asynchronously via queue - Rendered export stored via `ObjectStorageAdapter` with expiring download URL - `GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{id}` returns job status and download link when complete - `GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{id}/download` streams file with auth check - Export restricted to `Validated` and `Archived` documents only - Audit log entry for each export job creation and download - Export job has TTL; expired exports cleaned up by background task - Test: create export job returns job ID; completed job has download link; download requires auth; export of non-validated document returns 422; expired export returns 410 ### Acceptance — REQ-009 - Embedding pipeline triggered when document reaches `Validated` state - Documents embedded using `bge-m3` model and stored in `pgvector` table - `POST /api/v1/qa/ask` accepts question, retrieves relevant chunks, reranks with `bge-reranker`, generates answer via self-hosted LLM - Only chunks from `Validated` documents are retrievable - Response includes answer text, source document references, and confidence metadata - Non-validated documents never inserted into vector store (enforced at embedding pipeline) - Prompt logging disabled; query logged to audit with redacted content - Supported input formats for RAG: pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx - LLM model configurable: default Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, fallback Mistral-7B-Instruct - Test: embedding created only for validated document; Q&A returns answer with sources; non-validated document absent from vector store; unauthenticated Q&A returns 401; prompt content not in logs ### Acceptance — REQ-010 - Next.js 14 app router with OIDC login/logout flow - Authenticated routes redirect to login when session expired - Shared layout: sidebar navigation, top bar with user info and role badge - Shadcn/UI component library initialized with Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons - TanStack Query provider configured with default stale/cache times - Zustand store for client-side UI state (sidebar collapse, active filters) - API client module with base URL config, auth header injection, error interceptor - Role-aware navigation: menu items visible based on user role - Test: unauthenticated user redirected to login; authenticated user sees dashboard; role-based nav items render correctly; API client attaches auth header ### Acceptance — REQ-011 - Dashboard page: ingest count, processing queue depth, validation pending count, recent activity feed - Validation inbox page: table of AwaitingValidation documents with approve/reject/reprocess actions - Search page: search bar with filters (date, type, category), results list with pagination - Export page: select documents, choose format, create export job, view job status, download - Q&A page: chat interface, submit question, display answer with source references - All pages use shared components from REQ-010 - Loading, error, and empty states handled for every page - Responsive layout (desktop-first, tablet-compatible) - Test: dashboard renders stats from API; validation actions call correct endpoints; search returns and paginates results; export flow creates job and shows download; Q&A displays answer with sources ### Acceptance — REQ-012 - OpenTelemetry SDK initialized in FastAPI app with trace context propagation - Every HTTP request generates a trace span with request ID, user ID, route, status - Prometheus `/metrics` endpoint exposes request count, latency histogram, error rate, queue depth - Structured JSON logging with correlation ID, timestamp, level, service name, trace ID - Log sink adapter routes logs to CloudWatch (aws) or centralized log sink (onprem) - PII fields redacted in logs per `pii=True` column annotations from REQ-001 - Health check endpoint `/health` returns service status and dependency connectivity - Test: trace span created for HTTP request; metrics endpoint returns expected counters; structured log contains correlation ID; PII field redacted in log output; health check returns 200 when dependencies available ## Dependency Graph (textual) ``` REQ-001 -> (none) REQ-002 -> (none) REQ-003 -> REQ-001 REQ-004 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003 REQ-005 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-004 REQ-006 -> REQ-001, REQ-003, REQ-005 REQ-007 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-006 REQ-008 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007 REQ-009 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007 REQ-010 -> REQ-003 REQ-011 -> REQ-010, REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009 REQ-012 -> REQ-002 ``` ## Iteration Strategy ### Batch 1 — Foundation (S) - **REQ-001** (Data backbone) — Size: M - **REQ-002** (Profile adapters) — Size: M Unlocks: All downstream REQs have stable schema and infrastructure contracts. ### Batch 2 — Auth + Observability (S) - **REQ-003** (Auth/RBAC) — Size: S - **REQ-012** (Observability) — Size: S Unlocks: Protected API surface, traceable operations. ### Batch 3 — Ingest + Processing (M) - **REQ-004** (Ingest) — Size: M - **REQ-005** (OCR/IDP processing) — Size: L Unlocks: First end-to-end journey: upload → process → awaiting validation. ### Batch 4 — Validation + Archive (M) - **REQ-006** (Human validation) — Size: M - **REQ-007** (Archive/search) — Size: M Unlocks: Complete document lifecycle through validation to searchable archive. First operator-visible flow: upload → process → validate → search. ### Batch 5 — Export + RAG (M) - **REQ-008** (Export) — Size: M - **REQ-009** (RAG Q&A) — Size: L Unlocks: Full business value: validated documents exportable and queryable via AI. ### Batch 6 — Frontend (M) - **REQ-010** (Frontend shell) — Size: M - **REQ-011** (Frontend features) — Size: L Unlocks: Complete operator experience across all backend capabilities. **Confidence band:** ±1 batch for Batches 4–6 depending on OCR/IDP integration complexity and LLM serving setup. ## Test Strategy ### Per-REQ Mandatory Tests **REQ-001:** - Happy path: migration up creates all tables; CRUD operations succeed - Failure path: invalid state transition raises `InvalidStateTransition` - Persistence: audit columns auto-populated on insert/update - Idempotency: migration up twice produces no error - No-side-effect: state FSM query does not mutate document **REQ-002:** - Happy path: profile resolver returns correct adapter set for `aws` and `onprem` - Failure path: unknown profile raises `UnsupportedProfile` - Persistence: object storage put/get roundtrip preserves content - Profile parity: same adapter contract satisfied by both profiles - Queue roundtrip: send/receive message preserves payload **REQ-003:** - Happy path: valid OIDC token grants access to protected route - Auth deny: expired token returns 401; missing role returns 403 - Persistence: 401 and 403 events written to audit_log table - No-side-effect: token validation does not create/modify user records - Contract: `get_current_user` returns typed user identity **REQ-004:** - Happy path: upload PDF creates document in Uploaded state, dispatches queue message - Auth deny: unauthenticated upload returns 401 - Failure: unsupported file type returns 422; oversized file returns 413 - Idempotency: duplicate content_hash returns existing document ID - Persistence: document record and storage object both created **REQ-005:** - Happy path: ingested PDF processed to AwaitingValidation with extracted text - Failure: processing error increments retry count; max retries sets manual review flag - Persistence: processing job record created with timing and status - No-side-effect: processing does not modify original stored file - Contract: document in AwaitingValidation state available for validation REQ **REQ-006:** - Happy path: approve transitions to Validated with audit trail - Auth deny: viewer role returns 403 on approve/reject - Failure: concurrent approve raises conflict (optimistic lock) - Persistence: validated_by, validated_at populated; audit_log entry created - Contract: Validated documents available for archive, export, RAG **REQ-007:** - Happy path: search returns validated documents matching query - Auth deny: unauthenticated search returns 401 - No-side-effect: search does not modify document state - Persistence: search query logged to audit - Contract: only Validated/Archived documents in results; non-validated excluded **REQ-008:** - Happy path: create export job, complete, download file - Auth deny: unauthenticated download returns 401 - Failure: export of non-validated document returns 422; expired export returns 410 - Persistence: export job record with status transitions; audit log for creation and download - Idempotency: re-downloading same export returns same file **REQ-009:** - Happy path: Q&A returns answer with source references for validated documents - Auth deny: unauthenticated Q&A returns 401 - No-side-effect: non-validated documents never in vector store - Persistence: embedding created only for validated documents; query audit logged - Security: prompt content not present in application logs **REQ-010:** - Happy path: authenticated user sees dashboard with navigation - Auth deny: unauthenticated user redirected to login - No-side-effect: frontend shell does not create backend records - Contract: API client attaches auth header; role-based nav renders correctly - Profile parity: same frontend works against aws and onprem backend **REQ-011:** - Happy path: each page renders data from API; actions trigger correct endpoints - Failure: loading, error, empty states render for each page - Auth deny: role-restricted actions disabled in UI for unauthorized roles - Persistence: validation actions from UI create audit records in backend - E2E: upload → validate → search → export flow completable through UI **REQ-012:** - Happy path: HTTP request generates trace span; metrics endpoint returns counters - Persistence: structured log contains correlation ID and trace ID - Security: PII fields redacted in log output - No-side-effect: observability does not alter business responses - Profile parity: log routing works for both aws and onprem sinks ### Per-Batch Validation - **Batch 1:** Schema migration roundtrip + adapter contract satisfaction for both profiles - **Batch 2:** Authenticated API call end-to-end with trace and audit - **Batch 3:** Upload → process → AwaitingValidation integration test - **Batch 4:** Upload → process → validate → search integration test (first complete journey) - **Batch 5:** Validated document exportable and queryable via RAG - **Batch 6:** Full UI-driven journey: login → upload → validate → search → export → Q&A ## KIT Readiness (per REQ) ### REQ-001 — Data Contract Backbone - **Root namespace:** `backend.core`, `backend.db` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-001/src/backend/core/`, `runs/kit/REQ-001/src/backend/db/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-001/test/backend/db/` - **Primary module family:** `core.models`, `core.enums`, `db.models`, `db.repositories`, `db.migrations` - **Shared modules to reuse:** None (this is the foundation) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.core`, `backend.db` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.api`, `backend.auth`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Canonical schema, entity models, lifecycle FSM, repository layer, Alembic migrations - **Minimum production slice:** All tables created, FSM enforced, repository CRUD operational - **Downstream guarantees:** All entity models importable; state transitions enforced; audit columns present - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `core/models.py`, `core/enums.py`, `db/models.py`, `db/repositories.py`, `db/migrations/env.py`, `db/migrations/versions/001_initial.py` ### REQ-002 — Profile-Driven Infrastructure Adapters - **Root namespace:** `backend.adapters`, `infra.profiles` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-002/src/backend/adapters/`, `runs/kit/REQ-002/src/infra/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-002/test/backend/adapters/` - **Primary module family:** `adapters.contracts`, `adapters.aws`, `adapters.onprem`, `infra.profiles` - **Shared modules to reuse:** None - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.adapters`, `infra.profiles` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.core`, `backend.db`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Abstract adapter contracts + concrete aws/onprem implementations + profile resolver - **Minimum production slice:** All 5 adapter contracts with both profile implementations; profile resolver functional - **Downstream guarantees:** `ObjectStorageAdapter`, `QueueAdapter`, `EventAdapter`, `SecretsAdapter`, `LogSinkAdapter` importable from `backend.adapters.contracts` - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `adapters/contracts.py`, `adapters/aws/storage.py`, `adapters/aws/queue.py`, `adapters/aws/eventing.py`, `adapters/aws/secrets.py`, `adapters/aws/logs.py`, `adapters/onprem/storage.py`, `adapters/onprem/queue.py`, `adapters/onprem/eventing.py`, `adapters/onprem/secrets.py`, `adapters/onprem/logs.py`, `infra/profiles/resolver.py` ### REQ-003 — OIDC Authentication and RBAC Middleware - **Root namespace:** `backend.auth` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-003/src/backend/auth/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-003/test/backend/auth/` - **Primary module family:** `auth.middleware`, `auth.rbac`, `auth.models` - **Shared modules to reuse:** `backend.db.repositories` (audit_log), `backend.core.models` (User) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.auth` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.ingest`, `backend.processing`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** OIDC JWT validation middleware, RBAC decorator, audit logging for auth events - **Minimum production slice:** Middleware validates RS256 JWT; RBAC enforces roles; 401/403 with audit - **Downstream guarantees:** `require_role()`, `get_current_user()` importable from `backend.auth`; all protected routes use these - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `auth/__init__.py`, `auth/middleware.py`, `auth/rbac.py`, `auth/models.py`, `auth/jwks.py` - **API test assets:** `test/api/auth_test.http` with curl examples for valid/expired/missing-role tokens ### REQ-004 — Document Ingest and Upload API - **Root namespace:** `backend.ingest` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-004/src/backend/ingest/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-004/test/backend/ingest/` - **Primary module family:** `ingest.router`, `ingest.service`, `ingest.validators` - **Shared modules to reuse:** `backend.core.models`, `backend.db.repositories`, `backend.adapters.contracts`, `backend.auth` - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.ingest` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.processing`, `backend.validation`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Upload endpoint, file validation, storage, queue dispatch - **Minimum production slice:** Upload creates document, stores file, dispatches event - **Downstream guarantees:** `document.ingested` event on queue; document in `Uploaded` state in DB - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `ingest/router.py`, `ingest/service.py`, `ingest/validators.py` - **API test assets:** `test/api/ingest_test.http` with curl for upload, duplicate, unsupported type, oversized ### REQ-005 — OCR, IDP, and Classification Processing Pipeline - **Root namespace:** `backend.processing` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-005/src/backend/processing/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-005/test/backend/processing/` - **Primary module family:** `processing.consumer`, `processing.ocr`, `processing.classification`, `processing.extraction` - **Shared modules to reuse:** `backend.core.models`, `backend.core.enums`, `backend.db.repositories`, `backend.adapters.contracts` - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.processing` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.validation`, `backend.archive`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Queue consumer, OCR pipeline, classification, extraction, state transitions - **Minimum production slice:** Consumer processes document through OCR → classify → extract → AwaitingValidation - **Downstream guarantees:** Documents in `AwaitingValidation` state with extracted text and metadata - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `processing/consumer.py`, `processing/ocr.py`, `processing/classification.py`, `processing/extraction.py`, `processing/service.py` ### REQ-006 — Human Validation Workflow and Task Inbox API - **Root namespace:** `backend.validation` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-006/src/backend/validation/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-006/test/backend/validation/` - **Primary module family:** `validation.router`, `validation.service` - **Shared modules to reuse:** `backend.core.models`, `backend.core.enums`, `backend.db.repositories`, `backend.auth` - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.validation` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.ingest`, `backend.processing`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Task inbox API, approve/reject/reprocess actions, audit trail - **Minimum production slice:** List tasks, approve, reject, reprocess with RBAC and audit - **Downstream guarantees:** Validated documents available for archive, export, RAG - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `validation/router.py`, `validation/service.py` - **API test assets:** `test/api/validation_test.http` ### REQ-007 — Archive Storage and Full-Text Search API - **Root namespace:** `backend.archive` - **Source root:** `runs/kit/REQ-007/src/backend/archive/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-007/test/backend/archive/` - **Primary module family:** `archive.router`, `archive.service`, `archive.search` - **Shared modules to reuse:** `backend.core.models`, `backend.db.repositories`, `backend.adapters.contracts`, `backend.auth` - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `backend.archive` - **Forbidden paths:** `backend.ingest`, `backend.processing`, `frontend` - **Owned outcome:** Archive transition, full-text search
